<th class="th" colspan="1">9 Months Ended</th>
</tr>
<tr><th class="th"><div>Sep. 30, 2026</div></th></tr>
<tr class="re">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_GoodwillAndIntangibleAssetsDisclosureAbstract', window );"><strong>Intangible Asset, Goodwill and Other [Abstract]</strong></a></td>
<td class="text">&#160;<span></span>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="ro">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_GoodwillAndIntangibleAssetsDisclosureTextBlock', window );">Goodwill and Other Intangible Assets</a></td>
<td class="text"><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Note 7 &#8211; Goodwill and Other Intangible Assets</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;text-indent:18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Goodwill </span></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Business combinations involving the Company&#8217;s acquisition of the equity interests or net assets of another enterprise give rise to goodwill. Goodwill represents the excess of the fair value of consideration paid over the fair value of the net assets acquired in a business combination accounted for under the acquisition method of accounting. The Company&#8217;s goodwill assets are attributable to business combinations with 1</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:6.5pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;position:relative;top:-3.5pt;vertical-align:baseline">st</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%"> Capital Bancorp in 2024 and Lighthouse Bank in 2019. The value of goodwill is dependent on our ability to generate net earnings after the acquisition and is not deductible for tax purposes.</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Impairment for goodwill exists when a reporting unit&#8217;s carrying value exceeds its fair value. The Company&#8217;s policy is to assess goodwill for impairment on an annual basis during the fourth quarter of each year, and more frequently if events or circumstances lead management to believe the value of goodwill may be impaired. There were no changes in carrying value of goodwill during the nine months ended September&#160;30, 2026. At September&#160;30, 2026, and December&#160;31, 2025, the carrying value of goodwill was $40.1 million.</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;text-indent:18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Other Intangible Assets </span></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Other intangible assets at September&#160;30, 2026, and December&#160;31, 2025, consist of core deposit intangibles (&#8220;CDI&#8221;) attributed to core deposit relationships acquired in the acquisitions of 1</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:6.5pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;position:relative;top:-3.5pt;vertical-align:baseline">st</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%"> Capital Bancorp in 2024 of $27.7 million and Lighthouse Bank in 2019 of $3.7 million. CDI assets are being amortized over the projected useful lives of the related core deposits using dollar weighted deposit runoff on an annualized basis. CDI associated with the acquisition of 1</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:6.5pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;position:relative;top:-3.5pt;vertical-align:baseline">st</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%"> Capital Bancorp is being amortized over 13 years and CDI associated with the acquisition of Lighthouse Bank is being amortized over 10 years. At September&#160;30, 2026, CDI associated with the acquisition of 1</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:6.5pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;position:relative;top:-3.5pt;vertical-align:baseline">st</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%"> Capital Bancorp is expected to be amortized over a remaining period of 11 years and CDI associated with the acquisition of Lighthouse Bank is expected to be amortized over a remaining period of 3 years.</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The carrying value of other intangible assets, net of accumulated amortization at September&#160;30, 2026, and December&#160;31, 2025, was $20.9 million and $23.9 million, respectively, as shown in the following table:</span></div><div
